feature_name: Debian 8 Jessie base image deprecation for App Engine flexible environment
summary: The App Engine flexible environment is being migrated from Debian 8 Jessie to an Ubuntu 16.04 base OS, with opt-out possible by pinning to Debian 8; deprecated on 2018-05-30.
extended_definition: The App Engine flexible environment is being migrated from Debian 8 Jessie to an Ubuntu 16.04 base OS, with opt-out possible by pinning to Debian 8; deprecated on 2018-05-30.
